content: {"paper_id":"W1969954882","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-label Classification","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题直接点明多标记分类任务；摘要也说明每个训练样本同时关联一组标签，属于多标记学习。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"learns the correlations among labels while training the multi-label model simultaneously","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要称提出集成框架在训练多标记模型时显式学习标签间相关性，满足标签相关性建模。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"a low rank structure is adopted to capture the complex correlations among labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确采用低秩结构捕捉标签间复杂相关性，属于显式低秩表示或约束方法。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"we incorporate a supplementary label matrix which augments the possibly incomplete label matrix by exploiting the label correlations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以缺失标签导致的不完整标签矩阵为实质研究条件，并用补充标签矩阵进行增强，属于标签缺失型弱监督学习。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
